Tests that a custom provider can be registered and routes requests

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"my-model-v1\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    println(result)
}
```
